Field_Description: Determines the level gpio pin. Read returns the current value of the corresponding pin regardless of whether the pin is an input or an output;
RAWST bit: Interrupt raw status On Read returns latched raw interrupt status based on interrupt settings.
Writing 1 clears the interrupt raw status. Writing 0 No change.
Pos-edge interrupt enable; 1-Enable interrupt when rising edge (pos edge) is detected on gpio pin; 0-Disable interrupt on pos-edge detection
Neg-edge interrupt enable; 1-Enable interrupt when falling edge (neg edge) is detected on gpio pin; 0-Disable interrupt on neg-edge detection
GPIO Pin signal level on which interrupt should be generated. 0-generate interrupt on level 0; 1-generate interrupt on level 1
GPIO mode select: selects gpio either in output mode or input mode; 0-Set GPIO in output mode; 1-Set GPIO in input mode
dout: Value that to be written to gpio pin in output mode
